testcase.name: AT-01: [Happy Path] adding product and submitting valid name renders confirmation with ORD- reference, name, and exact amount
AT-02: [Validation] submitting with empty name displays error message, blocks confirmation, and preserves cart line
AT-03: [Calculation] updating product quantities computes exact line totals and order total via integer-cents arithmetic
AT-04: [Idempotency] rapid double and triple clicks on place-order trigger synchronous guard, producing exactly one confirmation
AT-05: [Validation] submitting with empty cart displays cart error, blocks confirmation, and preserves entered customer name
AT-06: [Data Preservation] removing items after entering customer name retains input value upon validation failure
AT-07: [Edge Cases] scientific notation (1e2), zero, negative, and decimal inputs revert to last valid quantity while >99 clamps to 99
